actions: OPEN INPUT CONTROL-FILE ACCT-IN OUTPUT ONLINE-OUT HOLD-OUT REPORT-OUT
MOVE 'NO BANK CONTROL RECORD' TO WS-ABORT-MESSAGE

rules.sentence: When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is not `ALL '0'`, it opens `CONTROL-FILE` and `ACCT-IN` for input and `ONLINE-OUT`, `HOLD-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT` for output; displays `'ACCTLOAD: CANNOT OPEN FILES '` `WS-FILE-STATUSES`; sets `RETURN-CODE` to 16; and stops the run.

When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is `ALL '0'` and reading `CONTROL-FILE` finds no more records, it opens `CONTROL-FILE` and `ACCT-IN` for input and `ONLINE-OUT`, `HOLD-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT` for output; reads `CONTROL-FILE`; sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'NO BANK CONTROL RECORD'`; and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is `ALL '0'` and reading `CONTROL-FILE` finds a record, it opens `CONTROL-FILE` and `ACCT-IN` for input and `ONLINE-OUT`, `HOLD-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT` for output; reads `CONTROL-FILE`; sets `WS-BUSINESS-DATE` to `BC-BUSINESS-DATE`; and performs `1200-READ-ACCOUNT`.
When reading `ACCT-IN` finds no more records, it reads `ACCT-IN` and sets `WS-MASTER-END-SW` to `MASTER-AT-END`.
When reading `ACCT-IN` finds a record, it reads `ACCT-IN` and adds 1 to `WS-READ-COUNT`.
When `AM-STATUS` is `'X'` (`AM-CLOSED`), it adds 1 to `WS-CLOSED-COUNT` and performs `1200-READ-ACCOUNT`.
When `AM-STATUS` is not `'X'` (not `AM-CLOSED`), it performs `2100-WRITE-ONLINE` and performs `1200-READ-ACCOUNT`.

actions: MOVE 'MASTER NOT IN ACCOUNT NUMBER ORDER' TO WS-ABORT-MESSAGE

rules.sentence: When writing `ACCT-ONLINE-RECORD` fails on its key, it sets `ACCT-ONLINE-RECORD` to spaces, sets `AO-ACCT-NO` to `AM-ACCT-NO`, sets `AO-CUST-NO` to `AM-CUST-NO`, sets `AO-SHORT-NAME` to `AM-SHORT-NAME`, sets `AO-ACCT-TYPE` to `AM-ACCT-TYPE`, sets `AO-STATUS` to `AM-STATUS`, sets `AO-BALANCE` to `AM-BALANCE`, sets `AO-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT` to `AM-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT`, sets `AO-HOLDS` to 0, sets `AO-AS-OF-DATE` to `WS-BUSINESS-DATE`, writes `ACCT-ONLINE-RECORD`, sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'MASTER NOT IN ACCOUNT NUMBER ORDER'`, and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When writing `ACCT-ONLINE-RECORD` succeeds by its key, it sets `ACCT-ONLINE-RECORD` to spaces, sets `AO-ACCT-NO` to `AM-ACCT-NO`, sets `AO-CUST-NO` to `AM-CUST-NO`, sets `AO-SHORT-NAME` to `AM-SHORT-NAME`, sets `AO-ACCT-TYPE` to `AM-ACCT-TYPE`, sets `AO-STATUS` to `AM-STATUS`, sets `AO-BALANCE` to `AM-BALANCE`, sets `AO-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT` to `AM-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT`, sets `AO-HOLDS` to 0, sets `AO-AS-OF-DATE` to `WS-BUSINESS-DATE`, writes `ACCT-ONLINE-RECORD`, adds 1 to `WS-LOADED-COUNT`, and adds `AM-BALANCE` to `WS-LOADED-BALANCE`.
